description: Only when the customer orders products with an age limit from several shops: start one age check with AltID with the highest age limit across all the orders (min_age from get_menu/quote_order) and reuse the age_check_id in every place_order (valid 30 minutes after approval, at any shop). With an order from one shop, call place_order instead: it shows the AltID card itself. Shows the AltID card (QR code / "Åbn AltID app") that updates by itself. Never make your own QR code.
name: start_age_check
title: Confirm age with AltID
